description: 서울에너지공사_발전소 전기생산량 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울에너지공사. 본 자료는 발전소 단위로 측정된 전력 생산 실적을 기반으로 하며, 주요 항목은 발전소명, 생산일자, 생산량(kWh), 설비용량, 가동률 등으로 구성된다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 서울에너지공사. Its tags are 전기, 생산량, 발전소, 발전설비, 가동률. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
